description: v0.1.0 Session plugin bridge for the unofficial VamMCP server. Load as a Session Plugin so it survives scene changes.
credits: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with Mesh VR / Virt-A-Mate.
instructions:
1. Put this .var in AddonPackages (or use the loose Custom/Scripts copy for development).
2. Main UI -> Session Plugins -> Add Plugin -> VamMcp.Bridge -> VamMcpBridge.cs
3. Session Plugin Presets -> set current as user default so it loads on startup.
4. Run the vam-mcp Python server with VAM_ROOT pointed at this install.
5. Keep VAM running. The plugin polls Saves/PluginData/vam-mcp/command.json
